ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

3. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

6. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

8. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

13. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain DC Generators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Generators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
